effective_labels.Description: All of labels (key/value pairs) present on the resource in GCP, including the labels configured through Terraform, other clients and services.

labels.Description:
Resource labels associated with this Namespace. No more than 64 user
labels can be associated with a given resource. Label keys and values can
be no longer than 63 characters.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

location.Description:
The location for the Namespace.
A full list of valid locations can be found by running
'gcloud beta service-directory locations list'.

name.Description:
The resource name for the namespace
in the format 'projects/*/locations/*/namespaces/*'.

namespace_id.Description:
The Resource ID must be 1-63 characters long, including digits,
lowercase letters or the hyphen character.

terraform_labels.Description:
The combination of labels configured directly on the resource
 and default labels configured on the provider.
